highlights: Biohacking devices help improve sleep, recovery, fitness, and overall health.
Start with simple tools like sleep masks, glasses, or wearable trackers.
Use gadgets wisely: track results, don’t overdo tech, and consult experts.

blocks.text: Best Sleep Devices

One of the essentials for our health is sleep. In the evening, our body recovers, so if this process doesn’t happen properly, you will feel it straight away. Anxiety rises, and low energy doesn’t allow for efficiency. Let’s have a look at a few top biohacking devices you can buy for [developing your sleep](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-sleep).
Sleep Pod System

These are special smart sleep systems. Using AI, you can control the position of the mattress as well as its temperature. This helps prevent your body from overheating whilst you sleep. Furthermore, such systems help track sleep phases and improve sleep quality. They also assist with waking up in the morning. Thanks to a gentle vibration, this smart mattress will gently wake you up without putting your body into a state of stress, which is often caused by the sudden sound of an alarm clock.

items: **Price:** from $1,299
**Popular models:** Pod 4 Ultra, Chilipad Dock Pro.

**Study:** [Research](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1364032125001479) suggests that personal cooling is effective in enhancing sleep efficiency, and reducing sleep onset latency and wake after sleep onset.

blocks.text: Sleep Mask

This old-school popular biohacking device can be handy. It can improve memory. It’s beneficial for those with sleep problems. Completely darkening the eyes increases melatonin production, and weighted masks also help further relax muscles. Silk or cotton is often used as a material. These natural fabrics allow the skin to breathe. This is an inexpensive, safe way to improve REM sleep and episodic memory. It’s helpful in bright rooms or on shifts.

items: **Price example:** $5-$80 depending on fabric and brand.
**Popular models:** [SOUND+ Deep Sleep Bundle](https://www.biohackers.world/shop/sound-deep-sleep-bundle), Therabody SleepMask.
**Research:** randomised studies show improved learning and attention scores with mask use, and recommendations from the Sleep Foundation and Harvard confirm its practical benefits.

blocks.text: Blue Light Glasses

Blue light from phones can negatively impact your nervous system and cause eye strain. Glasses with shortwave light filtering are suitable for evening use. They transmit the warm part of the spectrum and block ~470 nm. Some brands test using a spectral profile. With a blocking rate of 30-99%, yellow and orange lenses block more light than clear lenses. These devices can mitigate melatonin suppression during evening screen use and improve sleep.

items: **Popular models:** Gunnar, Swannies.

**Study:** the data is mixed: some RCTs show improvements in sleep and melatonin levels. In contrast, others suggest the effect is insignificant. It’s more beneficial when combined with avoiding screens an hour before bed.

blocks.text: Best Devices for Fitness

[Workouts](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/fitness-and-biohacking) are a big part of the biohacking routine. With some of these devices, you can enhance their functionality. Monitoring your data gives you more control over your body, which is why your results are also improving.
Smart Watch

This multi-sensor watch measures heart rate, steps, stress, and sleep stages. It also helps you train in specific zones. The watch lets you track all the most critical data. Heart rate monitor, GPS, [biohacking apps](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/top-biohacking-apps-for-health-sleep-brain-food-and-body), sleep tracking, notifications, training modes. The main advantage of such devices is that they’re always at hand. They allow you to keep an activity log and monitor your workload.

items: **Popular models** : Apple Watch, Garmin Fenix, Polar.

**Research:** a study of recreational runners found that data from wearable devices on overnight recovery helps adjust training loads and reduce overtraining. As training loads approached excessive levels, recovery metrics deteriorated earlier than subjective fatigue. This suggests that tracking devices do provide useful information for training balance.

blocks.text: Smart Rings

[Rings](https://www.mdpi.com/1424-8220/24/23/7475) are just as popular as smartwatches. They’re a minimalist wearable sensor that’s also stylish. They’re designed for 24/7 sleep, temperature, and HRV monitoring. The basic functions are similar, but the data is more accurate because this is the only feature of these biohacking devices. These wearable device technologies have a battery life of 3-7 days, feature infrared PPG sensors, and are waterproof.

items: **Price:** $200- $500, depending on the configuration.
**Popular models:** Oura Ring, Ultrahuman Ring.

**Research** : According to the articleSensors, asof 2024, the Oura Ring measures nighttime heart rate quite accurately compared to ECG, especially when data segments meet quality criteria, such as when the signal is more than 80% valid. However, HRV variability rates are higher than 10% error in older adults when data is collected over short time windows. It’s better to average reliable segments overnight or over a more extended period.

blocks.text: Best Recovery Devices

Proper recovery is essential for our bodies. During this period, the nervous system recovers and muscles relax. It’s important to relax both after exercise and after intense mental work. Massage and specific therapies, such as compression, will help restore balance and improve your well-being.
Infrared Sauna Blanket

A portable infrared blanket that generates heat for the entire body or a specific area is an excellent option for those who don’t have time to visit an infrared sauna. You can enjoy the experience at home with this device. The blanket features an infrared heating timer, temperature settings, and a convenient foldable design for home use.

items: **Popular models:** HigherDOSE Infrared Blanket, Sun Home Sauna Blanket.
[**Research**](https://www.cfp.ca/content/55/7/691.full)studies on infrared saunas show positive effects on blood pressure and some recovery support, but large, long-term RCTs are still limited.

Vibration Therapy Massage

Massage can help to get rid of multiple problems in one. You can handle fatigue, give your muscles extra strength, and enjoy the evening after a long day. Portable options give us the possibility of having a massage room at home. They feature various modes that can be adjusted to suit your needs, as well as attachments for targeted massage. Their frequencies typically range from 20–50 Hz, and their range of motion is 8–16 mm. This allows them to be used for both relaxation and toning. These gadgets are handy for athletes after intense workouts and for those with sedentary jobs.

items: **Popular models:** Theragun Pro, Hypervolt 2.
**Research:** meta-analyses and RCTs show improvements in flexibility and pain reduction, but the effects on large-scale recovery are inconclusive; studies support the benefit of local work.

blocks.text: Compression Therapy Devices

These devices help reduce swelling and relieve fatigue in the legs, wrists, and other muscles. They can be boots or cuffs that inflate sequentially, promoting lymphatic and venous drainage. Cyclic compression relaxes the targeted areas. Pressure typically ranges from 20 to 120 mmHg. They are often used by athletes and are helpful for passive recovery.

items: **Prices:** $800-$3,000 for professional NormaTec, and cheap consumer models from $200.
**Popular models:** NormaTec Recovery System, Rapid Reboot
**Research:** The data are mixed. Some studies show subjective reductions in pain and fatigue, while others find no significant effect on markers of muscle damage.

blocks.text: Pemf Devices

These low-frequency magnetic pulses penetrate tissue and influence cellular processes. They feature programmable frequencies and intensities, and are equipped with applicators for specific areas or a mat. These biohacking products can be helpful for those undergoing rehabilitation or wanting to strengthen bones and alleviate post-workout discomfort.

items: **Prices:** $200-$3,000. Home mat devices and clinical installations.
**Popular models:** BEMER, EarthPulse, Omnium 1.

**Proof:** Systematic reviews confirm the potential of PEMF, but the methodological diversity of the studies requires caution. The effects depend on the pulse parameters. [In several studies](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1089/bioe.2019.0026), PEMF has shown potential for regulating inflammation and accelerating some recovery; it is used for pain, bone healing, and post-surgical rehabilitation.

Best Devices for Mental Health
Maintaining mental health is a must-have in the modern world. Psychotherapy is an essential component, but some devices can also help clear your mind and reduce stress.
Smart Headband

These devices track calm and active states using dry EEG sensors. You get Audio biofeedback, meditation sessions, and some models include nighttime monitoring. The headbands can help with studying, concentration, and meditation.

items: **Popular models:** Muse, Dreams, SnoozeBand.

blocks.text: Vagus Nerve Stimulator

This is the best biohacking device for reducing anxiety and enhancing focus. It delivers special low-intensity electrical impulses and programmable modes. Due to their safe current dosage and portability, these stimulators are helpful for students before exams and during periods of particularly intense brain activity. Creative professionals may also appreciate them.

items: **Models:** gammaCore, AuraVNS, Nuropod.

blocks.text: [Research](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.2147/JIR.S163248#d1e467)shows improvements in cognitive function, mood, and fatigue resistance. A reduction in anxiety symptoms, improved mood, and decreased perception of stress are noted. It is helpful as an adjunct to psychotherapy.
Best Beauty Devices

Each of us wants to maintain youth and health as long as possible. Recent scientific research helps us achieve this. For example, we know that sun exposure is one of the main factors causing photoaging, so we apply SPF before going outside. But cosmetics aren’t the only way to improve your skin’s condition. Special devices can also help preserve it.
Red Light Therapy Face Masks
Special LED lights stimulate collagen and reduce skin inflammation. These masks have several different modes, such as pulsed or static. They also have a built-in timer for other wavelengths.

items: **Popular models:** Dr Dennis Gross, Joovv
**Research:** RCTs and systematic reviews show improvement in skin texture and reduction in wrinkles with courses of 2-3 times per week.

blocks.text: Microcurrent Face Devices

Weak electrical currents that tighten facial muscles and stimulate cellular processes are the primary purpose of such wellness devices. They usually have lifting and toning modes, as well as various attachments. Users report a tightening effect and reduced swelling.

items: **Popular models:** NuFace Trinity, Therabody TheraFace Pro
**Research:** while some [clinical data](https://www.e-jkc.org/journal/view.php?doi=10.52660/JKSC.2023.29.6.1505) support short-term improvement, long-term effects require regular use.

LED Hair Growth Devices

These options are suitable for stimulating hair follicles and improving scalp blood flow. These include helmets, combs, and panels that emit 600-680 nm light to stimulate follicles in patients with androgenetic alopecia. For effective results, 3-5 sessions per week are recommended. The effectiveness of these tools has been clinically proven. Their use has been shown to increase terminal hair count in several RCTs.

items: **Popular models:** HairMax LaserComb, iRestore, Kiierr.

**Research:** several RCTs and meta-analyses show significant increases in hair density in men and women compared to placebo with regular use; it is one of the best-studied home treatments for hair loss.

blocks.text: Blood Monitoring

Blood tests provide a comprehensive overview of your body’s condition. Just a few tests can help your doctor determine whether you need vitamins, dietary adjustments, or extra rest. A CGM, which monitors your blood glucose levels, is helpful for everyday biohacking. Try doing it every two weeks to learn how your body reacts to different foods. This way, you’ll be able to see what’s causing your blood sugar to spike too high and improve your diet. Regular lab tests, such as ferritin, vitamins B and D, and lipids, are also recommended. These can be done every six months or every year. This is sufficient to monitor your condition and give your body time to improve.
Home Biohacking Devices

You can improve not only your body but also your home. To make this space comfortable and beneficial, you can add a few gadgets that will enhance its health. Let’s see which biohacking devices you can buy for your home.
Water Filtration

An important part of our health is proper hydration. You can get a lot of minerals our body needs. If we ignore its quality, our efficiency could decrease as well. There are quite a few options for water filtration, which you can use for drinking water or as an addition to your shower. Most of them soften it with the help of an osmosis system. You will notice that the taste of water improves as it benefits your hair and skin.

items: **Models:** Berkey Water Filter, AquaTru Countertop RO System, Hydroviv Custom Filters.

blocks.text: Air Purifier

Air often needs to be purified. HEPA filters, carbon inserts, and sometimes UV modules remove fine particles and VOCs. This is especially important for people with asthma, allergies, and other respiratory conditions.

items: **Price:** $150–$1,000 depending on area and functionality
**Models:** Dyson Purifier Cool Formaldehyde, IQAir HealthPro Plus, Levoit Core 600S.

blocks.text: Advanced Devices
Next, we’ll look at options for biohackers who want to delve deeper than the mundane and aren’t afraid of invasive methods of influencing their bodies.

items: **RFID Chips.** These [NFC/RFID microchips](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/best-biohacking-implants) are implanted under the skin. That’s a part of experimental biohacking. They are used to access, identify, and store medical information. They can also be useful for payment and identification purposes. While this is a practical option and difficult to lose, it does come with its own risks. For example, cases of infection, chip migration, and interference have been reported in people who have had such chips implanted. So be aware of it if you want to try this tool.

**tDCS Devices.** These are weak Electrical currents of 0.5–2 mA through the frontal cortex to modulate neuronal excitability. In studies, tDCS improved learning speed and short-term memory with repeated courses. As the last trials showed, it can treat depression symptoms for some patients. Even home-based options. But still be cautious when using it. Inappropriate parameters could be either ineffective or dangerous, so please consult a specialist before using them. The effect is partly protocol-dependent and includes a placebo effect.

**CRISPR** . This brings us to genome editing. It’s used in clinical settings and research to treat hereditary diseases and certain types of cancer. Essentially, it involves cutting and inserting specific fragments of DNA. Although CRISPR therapies are undergoing clinical trials and have already been approved, they are a medical technology with significant ethical and regulatory restrictions, so they’re not for home use. It must be performed under medical supervision.

blocks.text: When Tech Becomes Too Much

While biohacking devices are a useful acquisition, as with everything else, they should be used in moderation. Don’t overexert yourself with gadgets; sometimes all your body needs is healthy sleep and nutrition, with minimal self-monitoring. Be wary of neurostimulators and all kinds of microchips. Such gadgets are more suitable for advanced biohackers, and even then, they should only be introduced into your life under the supervision of specialists.
Start with one or two new items, like a ring or bracelet. They’ll tell you about your sleep, track stress, and help you improve your health by monitoring these factors.
Practical Biohacking Tips with Tech

items: Be consistent. Don’t buy every device and collect data at once; sometimes, just slightly adjusting your routine, without going overboard, is enough.
Choose a tool that suits you. Be aware of your needs, listen to your body, and avoid choosing gadgets that won’t benefit you or are ineffective.
Define a specific goal. It’s important to understand why you need a particular device, for example, to regulate blood sugar or to make your skin look younger.
Research for clinical studies of devices. Trust only those gadgets whose scientific basis has been proven. Otherwise, you could harm your health.

Don’t trust every advertisement. Native advertising is everywhere these days, but it’s important to promote conscious consumption, especially when it comes to biohacking. Not every advertised device is right for you. Some are completely useless, especially those that are invasive or promise quick results. The most important thing is to avoid harming yourself.

Consult a specialist before use. Sometimes we don’t know what’s going on in our bodies, and even a handheld massager can cause unpredictable consequences. That’s why it’s important to consult with specialists about what you can and can’t do before using any, even the best, biohacking device.

blocks.text: Summary

We’ve covered the main biohacking devices, from simple devices like sleep masks and glasses to advanced ones like tDCS, PEMF, and CRISPR. Start with one or two biohacking equipment and monitor your results. Don’t replace the basics with technology. It’s better to first improve your sleep and nutrition, and don’t forget about regular exercise. [Beginners](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-for-beginners) should start with a high-quality sleep mask or trackers and one recovery device, like a gun or an infrared blanket. Some tips:

items: Pay attention to research and reviews of gadgets; don’t trust big brands.
Measure a specific metric and keep the device if it does not change after 4-8 weeks.
Consult your doctor before using invasive or medical devices.

blocks.text: It is important to note that none of the information in this article constitutes medical advice! The effectiveness of each device depends on many individual factors. It should also be noted that some devices have limited evidence to support their use, so particular care should be taken when using them.
